title: First load after restart to update (Leo, 2026-11-09: "the chat loading kinda flickered in and out and layout shifted"): a live fake chat with a transcript and a terminal beside it, the updater's relaunch, then the app's own frames from its first window frame. The chat must draw its last picture in the first frame and keep it until the live chat replaces it in place: no blank pane, no composer or row moving. Record with: cmux-ci capture SHA --state scripts/cmux-next/media/states/first-load-after-restart.json --video (a fleet capture slot: a reopen step does not run on the controller or Blacksmith route)

params.text: Read the launch path and say where the first frame comes from. The chat should come back as it was.
Now list every place the pane can go blank between the saved picture and the live transcript, one per line, with the file each lives in.
Last one: the composer keeps its place and its draft across the restart.

steps.title: A terminal split beside the chat
Quiet, so the page writes its copy (chatSnapshot/live.ts: 1.5 s quiet)
The updater's relaunch, then open the app again, recording its frames from the first window frame
Restored: the same chat, transcript and composer
The chat's open trace (debug builds)
steps.optional: older builds have no layout watch
